note: Humboldt County beach park off Hwy 101 about 7.5 miles north of Arcata, near McKinleyville: a gravel-lot campground beside the North Lot, behind a band of coastal scrub and open dunes that a footpath crosses to the beach. summary: Clam Beach County Park (Humboldt County): county facility + Parks & Trails pages + Google + Esri. Confirmed $30 cash/check, FCFS, 3-night max, no showers; added 13 sites and the annual-pass $5 discount. Coastal dunes kept: lot campground behind ~100 m of scrub and an open dune field, no road or day-use strip between it and the beach. Pin fine (~85 m).
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'coastal dunes' kept.
